title: Balanced Brackets with a Stack
statement: You are given a string made only of the brackets ( ) [ ] { }. A string is balanced if every opening bracket is closed by the same type of bracket, and the brackets close in the correct order. Use a stack to check this. Print YES if the string is balanced. Print NO if it is not.
inputFormat: One line with a string S. S has only these characters: ( ) [ ] { }.
outputFormat: Print YES if S is balanced. Otherwise print NO.
explanations: Each bracket closes right after it opens, so the stack is empty at the end. The answer is YES.
The ( is opened first, then [. The next ) meets [ on top of the stack. The types do not match, so the answer is NO.
